request: Rewrite this section of our design note.
input: There are four ways we could handle the rate limit and each has trade-offs. We could retry with exponential backoff, which is simple but can take up to 30 seconds on a bad day, or we could queue the requests in Redis, which keeps the UI fast but needs a new worker and loses the queue if Redis restarts without persistence. Another option is to ask the vendor for a higher limit, which costs nothing to build but takes about two weeks and may be refused. Finally we could cache responses for 5 minutes, which removes most calls but only works for read requests, so writes would still hit the limit.
